controls.name: Key Rotation
controls.enforcement: Authorized public keys must support rotation, revocation, and key id tracking.

controls.name: Voting Period Expiry
controls.enforcement: Governance proposals cannot remain VOTING indefinitely.
controls.test: Advance beyond voting deadline and assert proposal transitions to EXPIRED or requires renewal.

controls.name: Stake Concentration Limits
controls.enforcement: Single-node stake weight must be capped or normalized to prevent unilateral capture.
controls.test: Submit stake above configured cap and assert excess weight is ignored or rejected.

controls.name: DLQ Size Bounds
controls.enforcement: Dead letter queues require maximum depth, retention policy, and overflow behavior.
controls.test: Fill DLQ past configured limit and assert eviction or backpressure policy activates.

controls.name: Rate Limiting
controls.enforcement: Ingress queues may apply explicit throttle policy before overload causes uncontrolled failure.
controls.test: Exceed configured request rate and assert 429 includes retry metadata.

controls.name: SELT Audit Log Integrity
controls.enforcement: SELT audit events must be tamper-evident through append-only hashes or external anchoring.
controls.test: Modify historical SELT event and assert audit_integrity detects hash-chain break.
validation_criteria: SELT events include prev_hash and event_hash.
Audit integrity checks run on startup or scheduled cadence.

controls.name: FINALIZE_PROPOSAL Reverse Edge Creation
controls.enforcement: FINALIZE_PROPOSAL must create DERIVES_FROM and HAS_DERIVATION edges in the same transaction.

controls.name: compiled_block Fractal Metadata
controls.enforcement: REGISTER_FORK and FINALIZE_PROPOSAL compiled blocks must include artifact_id, schema_version, and policy_refs.
validation_criteria: policy_refs includes LAW-004, LAW-035, and LAW-042.

controls.name: Canonization Signature Custody
controls.enforcement: CANONIZE requires ARCHITECT and SENTINEL Ed25519 signatures; SENTINEL key must be active in AUTHORIZED_PUBLIC_KEYS.
validation_criteria: SENTINEL key is active and registered.

controls.name: GUCA Command Version Pins
controls.enforcement: Required GUCA command dependencies must be present, ACTIVE, and pinned to compatible semver constraints.

controls.name: CRDT Anti-Entropy Merge Enforcement
controls.enforcement: Distributed graph merge must use CRDT semantics and prove commutativity, associativity, and idempotence; LWW conflict resolution is denied.

compliance_findings.finding: Fork resolution uses timestamp-then-lexicographic last-writer-wins rather than CRDT merge semantics.
compliance_findings.remediation: Replace LWW fork resolution with a commutative, associative, idempotent merge function or mark distributed merge as unsupported.

compliance_findings.finding: FINALIZE_PROPOSAL creates parent_hash but no reverse graph edge.
compliance_findings.remediation: Create reverse edge in the same transaction or reject finalization as non-compliant.

compliance_findings.finding: Current server uses Ed25519 header signatures, not mTLS.
compliance_findings.remediation: Apply EXC-001 for local deployment or add mTLS for networked service calls.

compliance_findings.finding: Current storage uses JSONL journal and JSON snapshot rather than PostgreSQL foreign keys and ON DELETE RESTRICT.
compliance_findings.remediation: Add a relational registry layer or implement equivalent policy checks with tamper-evident persistence.

compliance_findings.finding: REGISTER_FORK compiled blocks omit artifact_id, schema_version, and policy_refs.
compliance_findings.remediation: Add required fractal metadata to compiled_block payloads.
